fields.description: Classic themes hardcode their pages. Sections themes build pages from sections/ and layouts/ that shops can rearrange.
fields.label: Theme Type

fields.description: Module the theme JSON is exported under when developer_mode is on. Its Module Def resolves the app the theme's files live in.
fields.label: Module

fields.description: App-shipped theme. Standard themes are never deleted from disk when the record is trashed.
fields.label: Is Standard

fields.description: bench commera theme new copies this theme when no parent is given. One starter per theme type.
fields.label: Use as Starter

fields.description: Single DocType holding this theme's editable settings. Use the 'Scaffold Theme Settings' button to create one.
fields.label: Theme Settings

fields.description: Inherit from this theme. A template or asset missing here falls back to the parent theme.
fields.label: Parent Theme

fields.description: Engine-level switches the theme declares about itself, e.g. {"rtl": true}. Presentational copy belongs in the theme's Settings Single.
fields.label: Config
